source.authors: Selthofer, Nikolic, Mrcela, Radic, Leksan, Rudez, Selthofer

original_table_locations.definitions: PDF page 2 (printed page 44) - Materials and Methods; Fig. 1

source.independence: Original osteological collection in Osijek; separate participants from NLM Visible Human and referenced Turkish CT sample, not identical data
limitations: Older cadavers averaging age 65; no stature distribution or male 182 cm conditional regression supplied
Table 2 lists whole manubrium/body/total lengths but does not provide a numerical level-by-level distance for all costal notches
Measurement endpoints and shape differ from imaging-derived landmark-frame controls
Means and SDs do not justify rescaling a single target or inferring joint/cartilage contact

male_table_primary.unit: centimetres for lengths/widths; degrees for angle
male_table_primary.total_length_endpoint: centre of jugular notch to end of xiphoid process
male_table_primary.manubrium_length_endpoint: centre of jugular notch to centre of manubriosternal synchondrosis
male_table_primary.body_length_endpoint: Separate body length defined by study Fig. 1; not HGPT a003 vertical depth
male_table_primary.manubrium_width_endpoint: first/second costal notch-bounded transverse breadth locations
male_table_primary.body_width_endpoint: between costal notches 2–7 at individually specified levels

comparative_existing_evidence.a003_stick_kind: Blender audit control, not verified identical to osteological total length
